description.zh: 按JSONPath点分路径过滤配置section，为空时返回全量配置
description.en: The path to the configuration section to retrieve, specified in JSONPath dot notation. If this parameter is empty, the entire configuration is returned.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb get-polar-claw-config --application-id pa-00000000000000 --biz-config-path models --region cn-hangzhou
